item.subject: science
item.stem:
For a school science activity, Priya mixes iron filings with powdered sulfur in a china dish at home. Her brother heats a similar sample strongly and obtains a black solid, iron sulfide.

Which observation shows that the unheated sample is a mixture and not the compound iron sulfide?

options.A: A magnet pulls the iron filings out of the unheated sample, but the heated black solid is not attracted to a magnet.
options.B: The unheated sample has one uniform colour throughout, just like the heated black solid.
options.C: Both the unheated sample and the heated black solid give the same gas with dilute hydrochloric acid.
options.D: The heated black solid can be separated back into iron and sulfur using a magnet.
